content.comment_body: When configuring multiple (or all) inputs to trigger a datalog write operation, is there an efficient way to identify which input initiated the request, so the function block knows which one was activated? Also, is it possible to set up an output flag specifically for the datalog block?
Hello, Could you clarify your question? The datalog function block can be triggered by any digital signal (positive edge), regardless of its source.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking how to determine which input signal initiated a datalog write in a [company_name] module and whether an output indicator can be created for the datalog block. The response explains the general triggering method but does not address identifying individual activating inputs or setting specific output flags. There remains some uncertainty about handling multiple triggers and tracking their sources efficiently.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants a straightforward way to tell which input triggered a datalog write and is looking for a built-in option or output flag to make this identification simpler.
